_about: [slurs] plainPerformance (the owner's "C", 2026-10-17): every event of a part played plain on its Performance patch goes this many ms early. Each value is the median of (heard - written) of the plain notes, measured in context: the passage played plain (abl.py's PLAINb, branch qt-bends, tools/soundlibraries/qt_bends/abl.py) through Kontakt 8 + SSO in kthost on the Windows test VM, onsets by the heard check's analysis (tools/playbackverify/heard_check.py). gen_spitfire_sso.py writes it as <Instrument plainShift>. A Performance patch not listed plays its notes as written (shift 0; the playback audit lists it). attackMs ([slurs] plainTiming, branch plain-timing, 2026-10-21): with plainTiming a plain note that is no transition starts this many ms early instead of shiftMs: the median heard - sent of the plain attacks (velocity 64, spiccato) in context, heard by the heard check's envelope rule (15 dB under the note's peak less 30 ms analysis latency, the rule the map's onsets use: Vos & Rasch 1981); gen_spitfire_sso.py writes it as <Instrument plainAttack>.
